long long modpow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

        long long order = 1;

        cout << ans << endl;
    } else if (k == 0) {
        long long ans = modpow(p, p - 1, MOD);
